fusions.name: Gavel Falls
fusions.desc: A downward blow that deals 24 damage and consumes every affliction on the target, adding 1.5 times their remaining damage. Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health.

fusions.name: Silence in the Hall
fusions.desc: Strikes the floor, dealing 12 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and stunning each for 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Weight of the Bench
fusions.desc: Increases your damage by 30% for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Flattened Ranks
fusions.desc: Your blunt damage cannot be resisted.
